questions.instructions: A stored memory note, summarised by `hook` with full text `body`, is filed at a level whose scope descriptor is `level_scope`. Every absolute path `body` cites lies in a different project tree; those paths are `cited_paths`. Is the note genuinely about that other tree, so it was filed in the wrong place, rather than a note about the subject of `level_scope` that only cites a neighbouring path?

criteria.true: the note is about the other tree: it is filed in the wrong tree
criteria.false: the note belongs where it is; the foreign paths are only references
